# Agent Maturity Compass (AMC)

> The credit score for AI agents. Open-source framework for scoring AI agent trustworthiness from execution evidence.

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#GETTING_STARTED)
- [Architecture](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#ARCHITECTURE_MAP)

- [API Reference](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#API_SURFACES)

- [Security](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#SECURITY)
- [EU AI Act Compliance](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#EU_AI_ACT_COMPLIANCE)
- [Scoring & Dimensions](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#DIAGNOSTIC_BANK)
- [Governance](https://agentmaturity.co/docs/#GOVERNANCE)

## Install
npm i -g agent-maturity-compass

## Full Score
amc

## Key Concepts
- L0-L5 maturity scale based on execution evidence
- Ed25519 + Merkle tree cryptographic proof chains
- 240 core diagnostic questions, 5 trust dimensions
- 14 framework adapters (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.)
- Evidence trust tiers: SELF_REPORTED (0.4x), OBSERVED (1.0x), CRYPTOGRAPHIC (1.0x)
